subject.title: Feature: allow account switching from /models buttons for GPT and Claude

question: Should `/models` grow a first-class cross-channel account/profile selector for provider-backed models, and what shared persistence/display contract should channels implement?
rationale: The lower-level profile pinning exists, but account choices affect provider routing, persisted session state, channel callbacks, auth-order behavior, and user-visible compatibility semantics.

options.title: Define shared picker contract
options.body: Add a shared account/profile picker model consumed by supported channels, with compatible profile lists and active-profile display.

options.title: Keep typed commands only
options.body: Declare `/model ...@profile`, `/model status`, and CLI auth-order commands as the supported account-switching path and close or defer picker UX work.

options.title: Pilot one channel first
options.body: Approve a narrow Telegram or Discord experiment while explicitly documenting that other channels remain unchanged until the shared contract is chosen.

recommendation.title: Define shared picker contract
recommendation.body: Add a shared account/profile picker model consumed by supported channels, with compatible profile lists and active-profile display.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the broadest sampled history across the shared model/auth/session and channel picker surfaces that this decision would coordinate.
